WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

from idea to launch.

01 / DISCUSS

02 / AGREE

03 / BUILD

Review progress, check the important journeys, and prepare the agreed product for deployment and handover.

BEFORE WE TALK

A few useful answers.

How much will my MVP cost?

It depends on the scope, integrations, and what already exists. Share your idea and budget range so we can discuss a realistic first version. You’ll receive an agreed scope and price before work begins.

Do I need designs or technical knowledge?

No. Start with the problem you want to solve and who it’s for. If you have designs, research, or an existing app, bring those too.

Can you work on an existing product?

Yes. We can discuss a focused feature, backend work, an integration, or improving an existing workflow.

Will AI be used to build it?

Where useful, I use AI tools to accelerate development. Product decisions, engineering review, and testing remain part of the work.

What about ownership and ongoing support?

We’ll agree code ownership, access, handover, and any support arrangement as part of the project scope.
